parameters.name: OBS_SEQUENCE_WIDTH
parameters.description: Width of the Stage 2E transaction sequence identity encoded in OBS_CAPABILITY.

current_monitor_pair.description: I_CH1 and I_CH2 are updated together from one destination-FIFO delivery, but separate software reads can straddle two deliveries.

fault_codes.name: OVERCURRENT
fault_codes.description: At least one channel exceeded its overcurrent threshold.

fault_codes.name: SENSOR_MISMATCH
fault_codes.description: The channel differential exceeded the mismatch threshold.

fault_codes.name: SENSOR_OPEN
fault_codes.description: At least one sensor-open detector asserted.

fault_codes.name: SENSOR_SATURATION
fault_codes.description: At least one sensor-saturation detector asserted.

fault_codes.name: SENSOR_STUCK
fault_codes.description: At least one sensor-stuck detector asserted.

fault_codes.name: OC_WITH_ANY_SENSOR
fault_codes.description: An overcurrent cause and at least one sensor cause occurred together.

fault_causes.name: SENSOR_MISMATCH_OR_DIFFERENTIAL
fault_causes.description: The channel differential exceeded the sensor mismatch threshold.

fault_causes.name: SENSOR_OPEN
fault_causes.description: At least one sensor-open detector asserted.

fault_causes.name: SENSOR_SATURATION
fault_causes.description: At least one sensor-saturation detector asserted.

fault_causes.name: SENSOR_STUCK
fault_causes.description: At least one sensor-stuck detector asserted.

invariants.rule: Exactly one public policy state bit is set at the Stage 2G policy boundary.
POST_CLEAR_RECOVERY_PENDING implies RESET_WAIT_STATE and excludes CLEAR_PENDING.
All bitmaps are zero outside FAULT_LATCHED_STATE.
Capture the complete first clean cause set once per active episode.
OR each clean eligible cause set during the active episode.

registers.name: CTRL
registers.description: Controls the demo PWM and submits the one-ACLK fault-clear request.

fields.name: pwm_enable
fields.description: Enables the low-voltage demo PWM carrier before protection gating.
fields.write_behavior: An accepted write stores WDATA[0] regardless of which nonzero WSTRB accepted the transaction.

fields.name: clear_fault_pulse
fields.description: Submits a clear request to the Stage 2G request/evaluation fence; it is not unconditional recovery.
fields.write_behavior: An accepted write of WDATA[1]=1 emits one ACLK pulse regardless of which nonzero WSTRB accepted the transaction.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved.

registers.name: STATUS
registers.description: Registered Stage 2G evaluation status and the public compatibility latch.

fields.name: fault_valid
fields.description: Registered fault-evaluation result, asserted only when evaluation-valid and the evaluated bitmap is nonzero.
fields.read_behavior: Returns the evaluation result three ACLK edges after the corresponding accepted atomic raw CDC destination delivery; it is not a continuously live classifier signal.

fields.name: fault_latched
fields.description: Public compatibility latch for an accepted fault episode.
fields.read_behavior: Retains its prior value through post-clear RESET_WAIT and clears only on a later clean healthy evaluation entering ARMED.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved.

registers.name: FAULT_CODE
registers.description: Stage 2G public first-cause compatibility code.

fields.name: fault_code_latched
fields.description: Latched first-cause compatibility code from the frozen fault taxonomy.
fields.read_behavior: Retains the prior first cause with fault_latched through post-clear RESET_WAIT.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved.

registers.name: I_CH1
registers.description: Latest atomic destination-FIFO delivery registered in ACLK for channel 1.

fields.name: i_ch1_mon
fields.description: Raw channel-1 monitor from the latest atomic destination delivery.
fields.read_behavior: A single register read is stable; a later I_CH2 read can observe a different delivery.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved.

registers.name: I_CH2
registers.description: Latest atomic destination-FIFO delivery registered in ACLK for channel 2.

fields.name: i_ch2_mon
fields.description: Raw channel-2 monitor from the latest atomic destination delivery.
fields.read_behavior: A single register read is stable; an earlier I_CH1 read can have observed a different delivery.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved.

registers.name: TH_OC1
registers.description: Channel-1 overcurrent threshold; equality is not a fault.

fields.name: threshold_ch1
fields.description: Channel-1 overcurrent threshold.
fields.write_behavior: An accepted write stores WDATA[11:0] regardless of which nonzero WSTRB accepted the transaction.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved.

registers.name: TH_OC2
registers.description: Channel-2 overcurrent threshold; equality is not a fault.

fields.name: threshold_ch2
fields.description: Channel-2 overcurrent threshold.
fields.write_behavior: An accepted write stores WDATA[11:0] regardless of which nonzero WSTRB accepted the transaction.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved.

registers.name: TH_DIFF
registers.description: Channel differential threshold; equality is not a fault.

fields.name: diff_threshold
fields.description: Absolute channel-difference threshold.
fields.write_behavior: An accepted write stores WDATA[11:0] regardless of which nonzero WSTRB accepted the transaction.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved.

registers.name: PWM_PERIOD
registers.description: Low-voltage demo PWM counter period.

fields.name: pwm_period
fields.description: Demo PWM counter period; zero holds the raw PWM low.
fields.write_behavior: An accepted write stores WDATA[15:0] regardless of which nonzero WSTRB accepted the transaction.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved.

registers.name: PWM_DUTY
registers.description: Low-voltage demo PWM high-time count.

fields.name: pwm_duty
fields.description: Demo PWM high-time count, clamped to the period by the PWM implementation.
fields.write_behavior: An accepted write stores WDATA[15:0] regardless of which nonzero WSTRB accepted the transaction.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved.

registers.name: OBS_CAPABILITY
registers.description: Stage 2E transaction-observability version and consistency contract.

fields.name: observability_version
fields.description: Observability interface version.

fields.name: sequence_width
fields.description: Internal transaction sequence width.

fields.name: counter_width
fields.description: Diagnostic counter width.

fields.name: counters_reset_only
fields.description: Counters clear only on reset.

fields.name: sticky_status_w1c
fields.description: Sticky status uses W1C semantics.

fields.name: source_telemetry_eventually_consistent
fields.description: Source telemetry is eventually consistent across independent Gray-counter CDC paths.

fields.name: atomic_multi_register_snapshot
fields.description: Atomic multi-register snapshot support.
fields.read_behavior: Returns zero because no atomic multi-register snapshot is provided.

fields.name: stage2e_magic
fields.description: Stage 2E capability magic byte.

registers.name: OBS_STATUS_W1C
registers.description: Sticky transaction-integrity causes and their read-only aggregate; a new cause wins over a same-cycle clear.

fields.name: BACKPRESSURE_SEEN
fields.description: At least one legal source backpressure cycle occurred.
fields.write_behavior: Writing one with WSTRB[0] clears the cause; a concurrent new cause wins.

fields.name: SOURCE_PROTOCOL_VIOLATION
fields.description: A stalled producer withdrew valid or replaced its payload.
fields.write_behavior: Writing one with WSTRB[0] clears the cause; a concurrent new cause wins.

fields.name: SOURCE_DROP_SEEN
fields.description: A pending source transaction was dropped or replaced by a producer violation.
fields.write_behavior: Writing one with WSTRB[0] clears the cause; a concurrent new cause wins.

fields.name: FIFO_OVERFLOW_ATTEMPT
fields.description: An illegal internal write-enable while full occurred.
fields.write_behavior: Writing one with WSTRB[0] clears the cause; a concurrent new cause wins.

fields.name: FIFO_UNDERFLOW_ATTEMPT
fields.description: An illegal internal read-enable while empty occurred.
fields.write_behavior: Writing one with WSTRB[0] clears the cause; a concurrent new cause wins.

fields.name: DUPLICATE_DELIVERY
fields.description: A duplicate internal transaction identity was delivered.
fields.write_behavior: Writing one with WSTRB[0] clears the cause; a concurrent new cause wins.

fields.name: SEQUENCE_GAP
fields.description: A forward sequence gap occurred.
fields.write_behavior: Writing one with WSTRB[0] clears the cause; a concurrent new cause wins.

fields.name: REORDER_OR_STALE
fields.description: A backward, stale, or first-nonzero sequence mismatch occurred.
fields.write_behavior: Writing one with WSTRB[0] clears the cause; a concurrent new cause wins.

fields.name: COUNTER_SATURATED
fields.description: At least one diagnostic counter saturated.
fields.write_behavior: Writing one with WSTRB[1] clears the cause; a concurrent new cause wins.

fields.name: ANY_ERROR
fields.description: Read-only OR of post-clear causes 1 through 8; legal backpressure is excluded.
fields.write_behavior: Ignored; writing bit 9 alone has no effect.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved.

registers.name: OBS_SOURCE_ACCEPT_COUNT
registers.description: Saturating count of source ready/valid acceptances; reset-only clear.

fields.name: count
fields.description: Source acceptance count.

registers.name: OBS_DESTINATION_DELIVERY_COUNT

fields.name: count

registers.name: OBS_BACKPRESSURE_CYCLE_COUNT
registers.description: Saturating count of legal source cycles with valid and not ready; reset-only clear.

fields.name: count
fields.description: Backpressure-cycle count.

registers.name: OBS_SOURCE_PROTOCOL_VIOLATION_COUNT
registers.description: Saturating count of stalled episodes with withdrawal or payload replacement; reset-only clear.

fields.name: count
fields.description: Source protocol violation count.

registers.name: OBS_SOURCE_DROP_COUNT
registers.description: Saturating count of pending source transactions dropped or replaced by a producer violation; reset-only clear.

fields.name: count
fields.description: Source drop count.

registers.name: OBS_FIFO_OVERFLOW_ATTEMPT_COUNT
registers.description: Saturating count of illegal internal write-enable while full attempts; reset-only clear.

fields.name: count
fields.description: FIFO overflow-attempt count.

registers.name: OBS_FIFO_UNDERFLOW_ATTEMPT_COUNT
registers.description: Saturating count of illegal internal read-enable while empty attempts; reset-only clear.

fields.name: count
fields.description: FIFO underflow-attempt count.

registers.name: OBS_DUPLICATE_DELIVERY_COUNT
registers.description: Saturating count of duplicate internal transaction identities; reset-only clear.

fields.name: count
fields.description: Duplicate-delivery count.

registers.name: OBS_SEQUENCE_GAP_COUNT
registers.description: Saturating count of forward sequence-gap events; reset-only clear.

fields.name: count
fields.description: Sequence-gap count.

registers.name: OBS_REORDER_OR_STALE_COUNT
registers.description: Saturating count of backward, stale, or first-nonzero sequence mismatches; reset-only clear.

fields.name: count
fields.description: Reorder-or-stale count.

registers.name: OBS_AGGREGATE_ERROR_COUNT
registers.description: Saturating count of aggregate error occurrences; legal backpressure is excluded; reset-only clear.

fields.name: count
fields.description: Aggregate-error count.

registers.name: OBS_LAST_SOURCE_SEQUENCE
registers.description: Last source-accepted internal sequence identity, zero-extended to 32 bits.

fields.name: sequence
fields.description: Last source-accepted sequence in the implemented width, zero-extended to 32 bits.
fields.read_behavior: Returns an independently synchronized source-domain value and is not part of an atomic multi-register snapshot.

registers.name: OBS_LAST_DESTINATION_SEQUENCE
registers.description: Last destination-delivered internal sequence identity, zero-extended to 32 bits.

fields.name: sequence
fields.description: Last destination-delivered sequence in the implemented width, zero-extended to 32 bits.
fields.read_behavior: Returns the ACLK-domain destination value and is not part of an atomic multi-register snapshot.

fields.read_behavior: Returns one on the fully connected Stage 2G production path.

fields.read_behavior: Returns one on the fully connected Stage 2G production path.
